lines: A short while before traveling down to Yomihara.
I finished leafing through the books piled up on the floor and sighed.
As expected, there isn't much material about the power of demons.
I was curious about what Kiryu Sabato had told me and was searching for information about the "power of demons."
However, almost all of the books in the collections at school and at home were about ninja and Ninja Arts.
There weren't many books about demons and thier powers, and I had finished reading through nearly all of those.
This is a village of ninja, so I guess it's only natural.
In that case, I guess the best way to find out about the power of demons would be to ask a demon...
The only demons I knew were the boorish Orc mercenary and those two mischievous little devils. They didn't seem like the most knowledgeable people by any standard.
...Hmm, if you haven't got a clue, then there's nothing to do but search.
I put the books aside in a corner of the room and contacted a certain girl.
Tokyo Kingdom, the abandoned city floating on Tokyo Bay.
Before anyone had noticed, it had become overrun, first by society's underbelly and then by demons, making it a demonic metropolis. And in this city, a market had been established by shady merchants.
Sorry for making you tag along, Shishigami.
Don't worry about it. I had just finished my mission and was on my way back to Gosha anyway.
In this market, filled with curiosities from the Devildom, there might also be books written about the power of demons.
Nevertheless, this was a dangerous city to walk alone in. So I had asked Shishigami to be my escort.
So? Do you think you can find what you're looking for?
Just as my chest was aflutter with anticipation, my clothes were yanked on by someone from behind.
Fuma-chan, Fuma-chan!! What is that? It looks like Hebiko's legs!
The excited Hebiko pointed to a street vendor showcasing strange, richly-colored fruits.
Yeah, that's a tentacle fruit. It's from a plant that grows in the tropics of the Devildom. Apparently, it's sweeter and tastier when it's a little underripe.
You can eat it!? Maybe Hebiko'll buy one.
Hey, hey, Fuma, look at that! There's a bunch of tiny little heads on display!? A-A-A-Are those real!?
Ahh, those are most likely victims of the Rakshasa Orcs. Apparently they specially prepare the heads of enemies they've hunted down and shrink them.
Hebiko and Shikanosuke looked all around with unbridled curiosity.
Sorry for them making such a fuss, Shishigami.
They seem to be having fun so it's all good. I'm always alone, so...
Shishigami was a student like us, but she didn't want to "cause trouble for people" because of her power, so she often kept to herself.
It was to the point where until we had coincidentally gotten caught up in the same incident, I hadn't even known her name.
But she's inconvenienced, for sure... by your curiosity too, Fuma-chan!
You say you want a book about magic, so you make Shishigami-san come with you to a dangerous place like this?
What's wrong, Hebiko? You're awfully harsh today.
I mean, you two came along on your own, didn't you?
Heheh, you're so thick, Fuma. Hebiko is mad at you, you know♪ Because you were planning to go on a date with Shishigami.
What are you talking about, Shikanosuke-chan!!?
It's not a date. I just asked her to escort me.
What, it's not? Then why did you come to a place like this without telling us?
That's... um... I told you about the incident I got caught up in with Shishigami, didn't I?
Where you were trapped in that labyrinth?
Yeah. There's no guarantee there won't be another incident like that, so I wanted to deepen my knowledge regarding everything magical and demonic.
So that's why you invited Shishigami, who was dragged into that incident with you.
Yeah. It wasn't that I was hiding anything.
Hmmm. I mean, we're always being saved by your knowledge, so no complaints here!
I was also saved back then. It's the same for you two as well, huh.
(Shishigami seems to be enjoying herself. Maybe it's actually good that Hebiko and Shikanosuke came with us.)
I suddenly stopped in front of one of the shops. Inside it was a certain familiar-looking man.
Yes, yes, welcome. Can I help you withーah.
A strange tension hung in the air.
Y-Y-You! What the hell are you here for?!!
Did you follow me all the way here!!? I told you that I was only hired by that woman back then, didn't I?!
No, wait, that's not what this is aboutー
It was Zocht, the demon who had been hired by the proprietress of the Chaos Arena to guide us when Hebiko had been kidnapped before.
A lot had happened then, and there was more than a little ill will...
Zocht started to ready his gun, but Shishigami was quicker.
If you move, I'll kill you. I won't say it twice.
Shishigami's blade was pressed against Zocht's neck.
Wait, Shishigami! I didn't come here to fight.
Hearing my words, Shishigami's intent to kill lessened some, but she didn't remove her blade from Zocht's neck.
Th-Then what the hell are you here for!?
I only wanted to ask you something.
A-Ask me something? I'll tell you anything, so please do something about this woman!
Shishigami nodded and lowered her blade.
You really are some terrifying kids... So, what did you want to ask about?
About the power of demons. Basically, about the source of a demon's power.
Do you know of any informationーlike knowledgeable people or shops with books about that kind of thing?
Beats me. Sorry, but it's outside my area of expertise. That's complicated stuff that only sorcerers and alchemists read about... Ah, wait a second.
Do you have something in mind?
Yeah, I've never met them, but there's someone close by who seems to know a lot about this kind of stuff... Of course, this ain't free though?
As Zocht returned to his usual self, Shishigami directed her murderous aura toward him once again.
Alright! I'll tell you!!! I'll tell you, so get that scary woman away from me!!
(I was right to have Shishigami come with me after all...)
After passing through the black market, we emerged onto a quiet street.
(There's a lot of well-kept houses here... I guess if there's people making money on the black market, it's not surprising that there's a more up-scale neighborhood as well)
We stopped in front of one of the houses.
So this house is the alchemist's atelier.
It's Hebiko's first time meeting an alchemist! I wonder what kind of person it is.
I bet it's some eccentric old guy.
According to what Zocht had told us...
An alchemist has set up their atelier nearby. The rumor is it's someone who has a peerage in the Devildom, so I guess they must know about this kind of stuff?
It's just something I heard though. Don't put too much stock in it.
An alchemist certainly seems like they'd be quite knowledgeable.
Let's go in right away then. Um, excu-...
When I instinctively dropped to the ground, a storm of bullets grazed over my head, accompanied by the sound of gunfire.
Aieee!? What's going on all of a sudden!?
It's the guys who got our old man!! Haaahh!!!!
As if to affirm that there would be absolutely no discussion, the bullets rained down again.
H-H-H-Hey, Fuma, did we kill someone's dad!?
With all the fighting up til now, I can't say there's no way we haven't, but...
When I sneakily peeked out from the shadows, I could see that the attackers were men that looked like thugs.
But even so, sitting here quietly and getting killed isn't an option!
Hebiko said as she turned into an octopus and got into her combat stance.
I agree. What do we do, Fuma?
You're right... Luckily there's not many of them. I guess we'll wait for them to run out of bullets and then counterattackー
At that moment, I heard a creak behind me.
Hearing the commotion, the owner of the house had come out.
And the attackers simultaneously turned their attention to the woman.
How dare you do that to our old man!!
Wait, don't shoot. You're Chevalier, the alchemist, right?
Stopping the zealous attackers, a man who seemed to be their leader stepped forward.
Well, well. It looks like some gnats chirping the name Chevalier have wandered in.
The woman seemed unfazed, and merely adjusted her gaze and looked at the men.
Stop screwing around! You had these Taimanin spread poison, didn't you?!
And look what happened to our old man because of that!
Chevalier doesn't know anything about that.
Alchemist Chevalier, come and fight me. If you want, you can toss in those Taimanin kids and fight me five against one.
Don't be silly. If you want to get violent, then please do it elsewhere.
Don't play dumb! You're the only one around here who could do something like that.
The fact that those Taimanin are here is proof above all else. I bet they came to collect their reward.
I wasn't sure what they were talking about, but the threatening attitude of the men made even the town's residents, who were used to bloodshed, stop in their tracks.
Hey, I don't know what's going on, but for now calm down and let's discuss it...
Shut up!!! Seems like I have to tear you all apart!! ー...GRRRGGHH...
The man suddenly let out a low growl and ripped off his maskー
Wh-What's wrong with this guy!? He suddenly turned into a wolf...!?
I've heard about them. Monsters from the Devildom that can turn into humans...
Werewolves!!!! This guy was a Werewolf!?
This looks bad! Hebiko, Shikanosuke, prepare for combat!!!!
